identity: A WR Station midrange deck that converts expendable bodies into one large evasive Spacecraft. Station is a cost that taps a creature WITHOUT using that creature's {T} symbol, so summoning-sick bodies pay it the turn they arrive, and each activation banks charge counters equal to the tapped creature's POWER - which is why this list deliberately runs high-power fodder (Vaultguard Trooper 5, Terrapact Intimidator usually 4, Sunstar Chaplain 3) rather than cheap 1/1s. The Seriema is the primary ship: a {1}{W}{W} 5/5 that tutors Sami on entry and flies at 7 counters, which one Drill Too Deep ('Put five charge counters on target Spacecraft or Planet you control') plus a single 2-power Station reaches. Galvanizing Sawship is the alternate kill, lethal on arrival at 3 counters off one big Station. Six of the twenty-three nonland cards are Spacecraft and three of them are removal spells on entry, so the deck answers the board with the same cards that assemble the kill.

identity_es: Un midrange de Station WR que convierte cuerpos prescindibles en una Spacecraft grande y evasiva. Station es un coste que gira una criatura SIN usar el símbolo de {T} de esa criatura, así que los cuerpos con mareo de invocación lo pagan el turno que llegan, y cada activación guarda contadores de carga iguales a la FUERZA de la criatura girada, que es por lo que esta lista juega deliberadamente forraje de fuerza alta (Vaultguard Trooper 5, Terrapact Intimidator normalmente 4, Sunstar Chaplain 3) en lugar de 1/1 baratos. The Seriema es la nave principal: un 5/5 de {1}{W}{W} que busca a Sami al entrar y vuela con 7 contadores, algo que alcanzan un Drill Too Deep ('Put five charge counters on target Spacecraft or Planet you control') más un solo Station de 2 de fuerza. Galvanizing Sawship es la victoria alternativa, letal al llegar con 3 contadores desde un solo Station grande. Seis de las veintitrés cartas no-tierra son Spacecraft y tres de ellas son hechizos de eliminación al entrar, así que el mazo responde al tablero con las mismas cartas que ensamblan la victoria.
